requirements.text: * 3+ years of experience in software development and application systems environments
* Demonstrated proficiency in some or all technologies like .NET, C#, Python, HTML, JavaScript, SQL, and Angular
* Requires an understanding and application of software engineering procedures and concepts within the discipline, along with basic knowledge of related technical disciplines.
* Understands key business drivers and applies that understanding to deliver effective technical solutions and complete assigned work.
* Has no direct supervisory responsibilities but provides informal technical guidance and support to new team members.
* Resolves problems in straightforward situations by evaluating potential solutions using technical experience, professional judgment, established practices, and precedents.
* Impacts the quality and timeliness of individual work and contributes to the work of the broader team while operating within established guidelines, standards, and policies.
* Communicates technical and complex information clearly and effectively in straightforward situations.
* Knowledge of AWS application development would be a plus
